018
019/**
020 * For non-dweller ships with a sort-of shroud.
021 */
022public class ShroudedMantleHullmod extends HumanShipShroudedHullmod {
023        
024        public static float HEAL_MULT = 0.5f;
025        
026        public static float LUNGE_COOLDOWN = 10f;
027        public static float LUNGE_DUR = 4f;
028        public static float LUNGE_SPEED = 250f;
029        
030        public static final float HULL_BONUS = 25f;
031        
032        @Override
033        public void applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation(HullSize hullSize, MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id) {
034                super.applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation(hullSize, stats, id);
035                
036                stats.getHullBonus().modifyPercent(id, HULL_BONUS);
037                
038                boolean sMod = isSMod(stats);
039                if (sMod) {
040                        stats.getDynamic().getMod(AssayingRiftEffect.HUNGERING_RIFT_HEAL_MOD_HUMAN_SHIPS).modifyFlat(id, HEAL_MULT);
041                }
042        }
043
044        public String getDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize) {
045                if (index == 0) return "" + (int) HULL_BONUS + "%";
046                if (index == 1) return "" + (int) CREW_CASUALTIES + "%";
047                return null;
048        }
049        
050        @Override
051        public String getSModDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship) {
052                if (index == 0) return "" + (int) Math.round(HEAL_MULT * 100f) + "%";
053                return null;
054        }       
055        
056        @Override
057        public CargoStackAPI getRequiredItem() {
058                return Global.getSettings().createCargoStack(CargoItemType.SPECIAL, 
059                                                                new SpecialItemData(Items.SHROUDED_MANTLE, null), null);
060        }
061
062        
063        public static String DATA_KEY = "core_ShroudedMantleHullmod_data_key";
064        public static class ShroudedMantleHullmodData {
065                IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.75f, 1.25f);
066                float hullAtPrevLunge = 1f;
067                float cooldown = 0f;
068                boolean lunging = false;
069                Vector2f lungeDest;
070                float lungeElapsed = 0f;
071                boolean fadedFlash = false;
072        }
073        
074        @Override
075        public void advanceInCombat(ShipAPI ship, float amount) {
076                super.advanceInCombat(ship, amount);
077                
078                if (!ship.isAlive()) return;
079                if (amount <= 0f) return;
080                
081                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
082                
083                String key = DATA_KEY + "_" + ship.getId();
084                ShroudedMantleHullmodData data = (ShroudedMantleHullmodData) engine.getCustomData().get(key);
085                if (data == null) {
086                        data = new ShroudedMantleHullmodData();
087                        engine.getCustomData().put(key, data);
088                }
089                
090                boolean forceUse = false;
091                
092//              if (Keyboard.isKeyDown(Keyboard.KEY_K)) {
093//                      forceUse = true;
094//                      data.cooldown = 0f;
095//              }
096                
097                if (data.cooldown > 0) {
098                        data.cooldown -= amount;
099                        if (data.cooldown < 0) data.cooldown = 0;
100                        if (data.cooldown > 0) {
101                                return;
102                        }
103                }
104
105                if (ship.getFluxLevel() > 0.95f && ship.getHullLevel() > 0.25f && 
106                                ship.getShield() != null && ship.getShield().isOn()) {
107                        forceUse = true;
108                }
109                if (ship.getFluxTracker().isOverloaded()) {
110                        forceUse = true;
111                }
112                
113                data.interval.advance(amount * 2f);
114                if ((data.interval.intervalElapsed() || forceUse) && !data.lunging) {
115                        float hull = ship.getHullLevel();
116                        data.hullAtPrevLunge = Math.max(hull, data.hullAtPrevLunge);
117                        if (ship.getFullTimeDeployed() > 1f) {
118                                if (hull <= data.hullAtPrevLunge - ConvulsiveLungeSystemAI.HULL_LOSS_FOR_PULLBACK || forceUse) {
119                                        data.lunging = true;
120                                        data.lungeElapsed = 0f;
121                                        data.lungeDest = null;
122                                        data.fadedFlash = false;
123                                        data.hullAtPrevLunge = hull;
124                                }
125                        }
126                }
127                
128                doLunge(data, ship, amount);
129        }
130        
131        protected void doLunge(ShroudedMantleHullmodData data, ShipAPI ship, float amount) {
132                if (!data.lunging) return;
133                //if (ship.getFluxTracker().isOverloadedOrVenting()) return;
134                
135                DwellerShroud shroud = DwellerShroud.getShroudFor(ship);
136                
137                if (data.lungeElapsed < 1f || data.lungeDest == null) {
138                        if (data.lungeDest == null) {
139                                data.lungeDest = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(Global.getSettings().getSafeMovementDir(ship));
140                                data.lungeDest.scale(ConvulsiveLungeSystemScript.PULL_DIST);
141                                Vector2f.add(data.lungeDest, ship.getLocation(), data.lungeDest);
142                        }
143                        
144                        if (data.lungeDest != null) {
145                                if (shroud != null) {
146                                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVector(ship.getLocation(), data.lungeDest);
147                                        float accel = ConvulsiveLungeSystemScript.PARTICLE_WINDUP_ACCEL * amount * 1f;
148                                        if (!ship.isFrigate()) accel *= 2f;
149                                        boolean affect = true;
150                                        for (SwarmMember p : shroud.getMembers()) {
151                                                if (affect) {
152                                                        p.vel.x += dir.x * accel;
153                                                        p.vel.y += dir.y * accel;
154                                                }
155                                                if (ship.isFrigate()) {
156                                                        affect = !affect;
157                                                }
158                                        }
159                                }
160                        }
161                } else if (data.lungeDest != null) {
162                        Vector2f dir = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), data.lungeDest));
163                        
164                        boolean slowdown = data.lungeElapsed > LUNGE_DUR - 1f;
165                        if (slowdown) {
166                                dir = Misc.normalise(new Vector2f(ship.getVelocity()));
167                                dir.negate();
168                        }
169                        
170                        if (!data.fadedFlash) {
171                                if (shroud != null) {
172                                        for (SwarmMember p : shroud.getMembers()) {
173                                                if (p.flash != null) {
174                                                        p.flash.fadeOut();
175                                                }
176                                        }
177                                }
178                                data.fadedFlash = true;
179                        }
180                        
181                        Vector2f loc = ship.getLocation();
182                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(loc, data.lungeDest);
183                        
184                        //Vector2f perp = new Vector2f(-dir.y, dir.x);
185                        
186                        float friction = ConvulsiveLungeSystemScript.FRICTION;
187                        float k = ConvulsiveLungeSystemScript.SPRING_CONSTANT;
188                        float freeLength = 0f;
189                        float stretch = dist - freeLength;
190
191                        float forceMag = k * Math.abs(stretch);
192                        
193                        float speedInDir = Vector2f.dot(dir, ship.getVelocity());
194                        if (speedInDir > LUNGE_SPEED) {
195                                float mult = 1f - Math.min(1f, (speedInDir - LUNGE_SPEED) / 100f);
196                                forceMag *= mult;
197                        }
198                        
199                        
200                        float forceMagReduction = Math.min(Math.abs(forceMag), friction);
201                        forceMag -= forceMagReduction;
202                        friction -= forceMagReduction;
203                        
204                        Vector2f force = new Vector2f(dir);
205                        if (slowdown) {
206                                forceMag = ship.getVelocity().length() * 2f;
207                                force.scale(forceMag);
208                        } else {
209                                force.scale(forceMag * Math.signum(stretch));
210                        }
211                        
212                        Vector2f acc = new Vector2f(force);
213                        acc.scale(amount);
214                        Vector2f.add(ship.getVelocity(), acc, ship.getVelocity());
215                }
216                
217                ship.giveCommand(ShipCommand.DECELERATE, null, 0);
218                
219                data.lungeElapsed += amount;
220                if (data.lungeElapsed > LUNGE_DUR) {
221                        data.lunging = false;
222                        data.cooldown = LUNGE_COOLDOWN;
223                }
224        }
225        
226}
